description:
FILED s517b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-16) from the IO-Compress census (#3161).  PRE-EXISTING: main dc87c403 crashes the same probe.

REPRO (perl 5.40.3 prints ok 1 - a / ok 2 - no warnings):
  use Test::More; BEGIN { require Test::NoWarnings; Test::NoWarnings->import; plan tests => 2; } ok(1, "a");
PCL: ok 1 - no warnings / no plan / SBCL backtrace (unhandled condition).

LIKELY CAUSE (not probed further): PCL's Test::More is supplied by the runtime (CLAUDE.md, shipped-modules step 3) while Test::NoWarnings loads the real Test::Builder and calls its methods on the shared singleton, so `plan` receives the wrong invocant / argument shape.  The fix layer is the Test::Builder bridge, not zlib.

IMPACT: IO-Compress-2.214-0 cannot be measured at all (0 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 93 FAIL, every file 0 rows): scratch/s517b/io-compress-rows.tsv in the s517b worktree.
